commuteAccess.summary: Both S3 endpoints are weak for public transport. Kvarnforsen is effectively car/pickup/long-walk access with no close transit and only unlabeled parking candidates 1.1-1.5 km away. sourceContradictions.topic: Current S3 boundary versus old Sandsjön-Kvarnforsen-Gyltige composite
sourceContradictions.details: Official Hallandsleden page/API/GPX define current Kvarnforsen - Gyltige, 24 km. Naturkartan slug, OSM relation 5599309, Wikiloc, Pacer and Destination Halmstad preserve old Sandsjön-Kvarnforsen-Gyltige 31-32 km framing.
sourceContradictions.importDecision: Use official GPX/API geo_json and current section identity as canonical; do not import the old composite relation as S3.

sourceContradictions.details: Official page/API display 24 km/24000 m, GPX desc says 23.5 km, computed official geometry length is 23.493 km and Naturkartan shows 23.3 km.
sourceContradictions.importDecision: Use 24 km as official display metadata and retain 23.5/23.493/23.3 km as source discrepancies.

sourceContradictions.details: Current page/API classify S3 as Södra delleden, but official GPX filename/metadata begins Mellersta_Kvarnforsen_Gyltige.
sourceContradictions.importDecision: Use page/API track classification; keep GPX filename as source artifact only.

sourceContradictions.topic: Kvarnforsen first point versus M6 handoff
sourceContradictions.details: Official S3 GPX first point is 162.1 m from M6 endpoint, but S3 point 4 is only 2.7 m from M6 endpoint. Naturkartan starts near this practical handoff rather than the first official point.
sourceContradictions.importDecision: Preserve official first point for S3 start coordinate and record practical graph handoff at S3 point 4.

sourceContradictions.details: Official S3 page says no toilet at Gyltige; Hallandsleden Gyltige place does not confirm water/toilet; Destination Halmstad and OSM say drinking water and dry toilet/toilets exist.
sourceContradictions.importDecision: Import Gyltige shelter/fireplace; keep water/toilet pending/conflict metadata until verified.

sourceContradictions.details: Hallandsleden places API returns Hålväg and Rödek for S3, but they are far/off-route and appear to belong to S2/Gyltige-side association.
sourceContradictions.importDecision: Suppress for S3 core import unless broad side-POI policy explicitly allows them.

sourceContradictions.details: Kvarnforsen and Gyltige are both weak for public transport despite being official endpoints; closest useful stops require long walks/continuation.
sourceContradictions.importDecision: Mark both endpoints as weak transit access and model car/pickup/continuation metadata.

researchIterations.mainThreadSynthesis: Evidence is strong enough for research-ready S3 without a targeted follow-up batch. Remaining weaknesses are explicit import caveats: Kvarnforsen first-point spur/handoff modeling, weak endpoint transit, Gyltige water/toilet conflict, Kvarnforsen access-dependent water/shower/firewood, stale old Sandsjön composite geometry/naming and dynamic fire/forestry/currentness checks.

importReadiness.identity: ready: canonical official identity is Kvarnforsen - Gyltige, Södra delleden, S3 local/inventory label, official order 19, 24 km, medium/blue, no official walking time.
importReadiness.appDescriptionDraft: From Kvarnforsen the route follows varied roads, gravel roads and forest terrain south toward Gyltige. It passes views over Hagasjön near Mjälahult, Mjälahults chapel, farms and lakes, the old Ynnabo oak, Lurehus and water crossings at Fylleån and Hällabäcken before reaching the Gyltige shelter/campsite junction.
importReadiness.geometry: ready with caveats: official GPX/API geo_json is canonical 247-point 23.493 km line; Hallandsleden line.geometry is empty, Naturkartan is shifted/generalized with stale slug, and OSM relation 5599309 is old composite Sandsjön-Kvarnforsen-Gyltige geometry.
importReadiness.endpoints: ready with caveats: official S3 start is Kvarnforsen 56.895058,13.186319 but practical M6 handoff is near S3 point 4; Gyltige end is coherent with S2/S4 within 1.5-9.2 m.
importReadiness.commuteAccess: ready with caveats: both endpoints have weak public transit; Kvarnforsen is remote with uncertain parking and long bus/rail access, while Gyltige has good parking/pickup but transit requires continuation toward Simlångsdalen/Brearedsskolan.
importReadiness.facilities: mostly ready: Kvarnforsen/Gyltige shelters/fireplaces, Kvarnforsen dry toilet/rubbish, Mjälahults kapell, Ynnabo eken, Lurehus and Fylleån are well sourced; Gyltige water/toilet, Kvarnforsen access-dependent water/shower/firewood, Pensionat Sågknorren and off-route leakage need policy/currentness decisions.
importReadiness.water: not reliable as fully confirmed public pins: Kvarnforsen water is access-dependent via property owner and Gyltige water is supported by Destination Halmstad/OSM but not confirmed in Hallandsleden S3 data.
importReadiness.campingFire: ready with caveats: shelters/fireplaces at Kvarnforsen and Gyltige, Kvarnforsen dry toilet/rubbish; fires require designated fireplaces and live Hylte/Halmstad fire-risk checks.
importReadiness.rulesSafety: ready with dynamic caveats: add Fylleån Natura 2000 crossing, Fylleån/Hällabäcken bridge/high-water awareness, road/gravel walking, dog/livestock/hunting/fire rules, forestry currentness risks near km 21-23 and future road-project watch only.
